page.overview:
What is Abholos?

Abholos (also known as Devourer in the Mist) is a fictional entity created by Robin Laws for the Trail of Cthulhu gaming supplement Stunning Eldritch Tales.

Abholos is a Great Old One who appears to be a great grey, festering glob of endless malevolence. According to one account, he is a product of Ghisguth and Zstylzhemghi mating, which also gave birth to Tsathoggua. This made Abholos more of a self-willed placenta that had taken form in-and-of-itself, rather than a brother or cousin of the others.

According to another account, Abholos is a spawn of Cthulhu, born from his bile and tears.
